args.title: Ironbark Tooling Newsletter Summary – Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Ironbark Tooling's latest issue highlights "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," linking to a blog article and a companion piece (registered using daniel.ferreira@northwind.example).
- Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data in real time; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilots using this live-sharing approach cut claims by roughly a quarter, reinforcing the article's findings on reduced rejections/claims.
